top.text: Corrupts the target, causing 438 Shadow damage over 18 sec.
Physical damage caused by the target is reduced by 37 for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.
Converts 848 Health into 848 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted.

spells.name: Bane of Agony
reasons: Called Curse of Agony in Classic

top.text: Afflicts the target with agony, causing 552 Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Bane reaches its full duration. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.
Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

Drains the soul of the target, causing 420 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Non-trivial targets damaged by Drain Soul have a chance to grant you a Soul Shard. Non-trivial targets killed by Drain Soul will always grant you a Soul shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.

Curses the target with recklessness, reducing the target's armor by 505 for 2 min. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.
Transfers 51 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

spells.name: Curse of the Elements
reasons: Ranks 1 to 3 trained earlier than in Classic
Rank 4 new (Classic stops at rank 3)

top.text: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Magic resistances by 75 and increasing Magic damage taken by 10%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Drain Mana
reasons: Rank 1 differ from Classic

top.text: Transfers 140 Mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.
Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 60%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Siphon Life
reasons: A talent in Classic and in Forever

top.text: Transfers 41 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.
Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 15 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.
Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 460 Shadow damage. The caster gains 100% of the damage caused in health.

spells.name: Bane of Doom
reasons: Called Curse of Doom in Classic

top.text: Afflicts the target with impending doom, causing 1742 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Amplify Curse
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it
A talent in Classic too

top.text: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Curse of Exhaustion
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it
A talent in Classic too

top.text: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Wrack
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it
Not a talent in Classic

top.text: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting 86 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10% for 6 sec.
Protects the caster, increasing armor by 120 and increases health regeneration by 5 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.
Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

spells.name: Create Healthstone
reasons: Ranks replace Classic's Create Healthstone (Minor), Create Healthstone (Lesser), Create Healthstone, Create Healthstone (Greater), Create Healthstone (Major)

top.text:
Creates a Major Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 1440 health.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.
Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.
Gives 153 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels. Generates reduced threat.
Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

spells.name: Create Soulstone
reasons: Ranks replace Classic's Create Soulstone (Minor), Create Soulstone (Lesser), Create Soulstone, Create Soulstone (Greater), Create Soulstone (Major)

top.text:
Creates a Major Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 2200 health and 2800 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.
Protects the caster, increasing armor by 570, Shadow resistance by 15 and increases health regeneration by 15 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.

Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.
Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye moves quickly but is very fragile.
Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.

spells.name: Detect Invisibility
reasons: Ranks replace Classic's Detect Lesser Invisibility, Detect Invisibility, Detect Greater Invisibility

top.text: Allows the friendly target to detect greater invisibility for 10 min.
Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 30 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Only works on Demons and Elementals.

spells.name: Create Firestone
reasons: Ranks replace Classic's Create Firestone (Lesser), Create Firestone, Create Firestone (Greater), Create Firestone (Major)

top.text:
Creates a Major Firestone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Fire, increasing your spell critical strike chance by 2% and the damage done by your Fire spells by up to 21.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Subjugates the target demon, up to level 64, forcing it to do your bidding. While subjugated, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 40% and its casting speed is slowed by 30%. Lasts up to 5 min. If you repeatedly subjugate the same demon, it will become more difficult to control with each attempt.
Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.
Absorbs 920 shadow damage. Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Create Spellstone
reasons: Ranks replace Classic's Create Spellstone, Create Spellstone (Greater), Create Spellstone (Major)

top.text:
Creates a Major Spellstone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Shadow, increasing your spell haste by 2% and the damage done by your Shadow spells by up to 21.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 5 min. Once control is lost, the Infernal must be Subjugated to maintain control. Can only be used outdoors.

spells.name: Portal of Summoning
reasons: Not in Classic
Season of Discovery had a spell by this name

top.text: Begins a ritual that creates a summoning portal. The summoning portal can be used by 2 party or raid members to summon a targeted party or raid member. The ritual portal requires the caster and 2 additional party or raid members to complete. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard. The doomguard must be immediately subjugated or it will attack the ritual participants. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

spells.name: Demonic Sacrifice
reasons: A talent: it comes with the talent point, no trainer teaches it
A talent in Classic too

top.text:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hr. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

A talent in Classic too

top.text: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

Burn the enemy's soul, causing 390 to 487 Fire damage.
